🛡️ 4.5A: Barovian Factions, Secret Orders, Covens & Court of Ravenloft (9 Dossiers)
🔮 1. The Vistani Mist Nomads

Mortal travelers bound by Strahd's ancient 347 BC Blood-Oath. Covers the Mist Passport & one-way trap, Madam Eva's hidden Zarovich bloodline, Tser Pool vs. Luvash's camp, and Piper's Blank Tarokka Card.

🦅 2. Keepers of the Feather Secret Wereravens

Clandestine wereraven resistance led by the Martikov clan (descended from The Seeker's lore). Covers Davian & Urwin's ten-year rift, the stolen Life-Gems, strict secrecy doctrine, and Kolyan's Diary.

🐉 3. Order of the Silver Dragon Fallen Chivalry

Paladins of silver wyrm Argynvost who secretly guarded Mount Ghakis before the 347 BC siege. Explores Vladimir Horngaard's bitter paradox vs. Sir Godfrey's love and the Campaign 3 Dragon Lands mural.

🧝‍♂️ 4. The Dusk Elves Doomed Remnant

Barovia's ancient twilight elves betrayed by exile Rahadin. Details Patrina Velikovna's Amber ambition, her stoning by elders, Strahd's slaughter of every Dusk Elf woman, the Deathly Choir, and Kasimir's grief.

⛰️ 5. Mountain & Forest Folk Wild Apostates

Descendants of Girvisa's First Folk and Chieftain Kavan who turned from the Ladies Three after Strahd usurped the Fanes—degenerating into blood-druids worshiping Strahd as the valley's storm god.

🥧 6. Old Bonegrinder Coven Fiendish Coven

Extraplanar Night Hags Morgantha, Bella & Offalia from the Gray Waste. Explores their seizure of the Durst granary, desecration of the Four Megaliths, the Dream Pastry addiction cycle, and S1's grudge against Piper.

🩸 7. Court of Castle Ravenloft Vampire Court

Book & Reloaded inner hierarchy of Strahd's household: Ludmilla (cold arcanist), Anastrasya (Vallaki socialite), Volenta (porcelain stalker), trembling consort Escher, and stoic Rahadin.

🐺 8. Children of Mother Night Pack Civil War

Border-raiding lycanthropes serving Mother Night, fractured by Ludmilla's betrayal: chained mercy-alpha Emil Toranescu and grieving mate Zuleika against cruel usurper Kiril Stoyanovich.

💀 9. Priests of Osybus & Dursts Ancient Necro-Cult

Secret necromantic brotherhood that whispered Mount Ghakis's Vampyr lore to mortal Strahd in 350 BC—linking the Durst family's cursed townhouse, Old Bonegrinder's deed, and Wachter cellar echoes.

🏘️ 4.5B: All 25 Barovian Locations — Book + Reloaded Historical Chronicles & Deep Lore (25 Dossiers)
🚪 10. Gates of BaroviaAct I • Areas A–B

King Barov's eastern granite border facing old Delmor, the 351 BC planar shear that decapitated both stone monarchs, one-way Mist sorcery, and courier Dalvan Olensky's thirteen-notch loop.

🌲 11. Svalich WoodsAct I • Old Svalich Rd

Once a sunlit imperial trade artery across the valley, now a sun-starved pine cathedral ruled by Strahd's usurped Huntress beasts, phantom Skeletal Cavalry, and Morgantha's lonely pushcart lanes.

🏚️ 12. Village of BaroviaAct I • Areas E1–E3

Pre-Ravenloft market hamlet eroded by four centuries directly beneath Pillarstone Crag: barricaded streets (Reloaded Arc B), the scarred Blood on the Vine sign, Bildrath's greed, and Mad Mary's lost child.

🕯️ 13. Indirovich ManorAct I • Area E4

Century-old Burgomaster residence: the foundling adoption of lost five-year-old Ireena, the twelve-night siege testing the Law of Forbiddance, Kolyan's fatal collapse, and his hidden Keepers friendship.

⛪ 14. Barovia ChurchAct I • Area E5

Five-century riverstone chapel stripped of consecration in 351 BC, Father Donavich's agonizing watch over starved rebel-spawn Doru (Reloaded Arc B5), the graveyard's March of the Dead, and Derek's freeze.

🌊 15. Tser Falls & CrossroadsAct I • Areas F & H

The 347 BC rebel gallows overlooking eleven unmarked graves, Delmor's four-gargoyle span above a thousand-foot cataract, Mordenkainen's 734 BC defeat, Strahd's poised Crossroads debut, and Cael's reveal.

🔮 16. Tser Pool CampAct I • Area G

Glacial basin protected since 347 BC by Strahd's unbreakable Vistani Blood-Oath, where hidden half-sister Madam Eva (Katarina von Zarovich) reads fate beside the bonfire and recoils from Piper's Blank Card.

🥧 17. Old BonegrinderAct I • Areas O1–O4

The prehistoric Four Cities Megaliths (ancient Seeker Fane stones) standing behind the old Durst family granary—seized by Morgantha's Night Hags to turn desperate grief into Dream Pastries.

⚔️ 18. Town of VallakiAct II • Ch. 5

Fortified lakeside bastion ruled by Baron Vargas's tyrannical happiness delusion while 'Vasili von Holtz' walks unchallenged inside—hiding Izek & Ireena's lost sibling past, Victor's cruelty, and the lakeside exile camp.

🦅 19. Blue Water InnAct II • Area N2

Urban heart of the Keepers of the Feather where exiled son Urwin & Danika Martikov maintain quiet tavern warmth, Rictavio observes secretly from corner shadows, and Kolyan's Diary proves trust.

✝️ 20. St. Andral's ChurchAct II • Area N1

Vallaki's four-century hallowed refuge raised over martyred bishop Saint Andral's relics—explaining Father Lucian's quiet mercy, orphan Milivoj's coercion, and why breaking its ward unleashes the Feast.

⚰️ 21. Henrik's Coffin ShopAct II • Area N6

Lonely carpenter Henrik van der Voort's workshop—explaining how 'Vasili von Holtz' and Bride Anastrasya used freight ledgers and quiet terror to smuggle Ravenloft grave-dirt and break St. Andral's bones.

🕯️ 22. WachterhausAct II • Area N4

Ancestral manor honoring Lady Lovina Wachter's 351 BC loyalty and guarding traitor Leo Dilisnya's iron bone chest—now home to cold widow Fiona, embalmed Nikolai, broken Stella, and Strahd's Tome.

🍷 23. Wizard of WinesAct II • Areas W1–W20

⚖️ SECTION 5: BAROVIAN GOTHIC LAWS, DIFFICULTY DCS & TABLE HOUSE RULES GLANCEABLE TABLE RULINGS
📜 The Four Sacred Laws of Barovia

1. Law of Forbiddance: Vampires cannot enter private homes without an explicit invitation from a living occupant. (Taverns, shops, churches & ruined manors do not count!)

2. Law of the Overcast Sky: Barovia's natural daytime is filtered through perpetual storm clouds and fog—it never triggers Vampire Sunlight Hypersensitivity (only The Sunsword, Holy Symbol of Ravenkind, and Dawn spell do!).

3. Law of Running Water: Ending a turn in running river water (Ivlis River, Tser Falls) deals 20 Acid damage and suppresses vampire regeneration.

4. Law of the Mists (Dark Whisper): 2 failed Death Saves in Act I–II triggers a split-second time freeze: a voice in the Mists offers revival at 1 HP in exchange for accepting a permanent Dark Power Touched Mark!

5. Law of the Frozen Second (Derek's Blind Spot): Whenever Derek (Avatar of the Dark Powers) visits (tap, tap, tap), time freezes completely. Because he walks strictly between the ticks of the clock, Count Strahd, his spies, and Barovian NPCs have ZERO knowledge that Derek exists!

🎲 Universal Table House Rules

Brutal Crits (Nat 20): Max Base Die + 1 Rolled Die + Modifier (automatically calculated when you roll a Nat 20 in the monster window!).

2-Strike Death Saves: 1 Success stabilizes at 1 HP (prone). 2 Failures = Death (or Dark Power Bargain).

Drinking Potions: Bonus Action for self (2d6 + 1 HP); Action to feed a downed ally.

Short Rest Healing: Restores 25% of Max HP (up to 2/day) and regains +1 Help Token (max 2/2).

2-Coin Economy: 10 Silver Pieces (SP) = 1 Gold Piece (GP).

🎯 Session 1 Difficulty DC Ladder

• DC 10 (Easy): Balancing on slick carriage roof, spotting wolf tracks in mud.
• DC 12 (Moderate): Reactive Harry weapon grip, relighting parlor lamps in Blood-Mist, spotting Cael's starry cat eyes.
• DC 13 (Challenging): Steering carriage around hairpin cliff, resisting Dire Wolf Prone bite or Alpha Howl, spotting ceilingsplinters.
• DC 14 (Hard): Escaping Vampire Spawn Talon Grapple/Restrain, resisting Ceiling Pounce or Blood-Mist Blindness.
• DC 15 (Very Hard): Resisting Choking Mists outside the Gates of Barovia.
